experience.organization: Prinses Maxima Centre for Pediatric Oncology
bullets: Building deep-learning and MIL pipelines for WSI analysis of Wilms tumor, spanning anaplasia grading, biomarker extraction, and outcome modeling in pediatric oncology.
Building reproducible computational pathology workflows for multi-center data integration and clinically interpretable model outputs.
Collaborating with pathologists and pediatric oncologists to translate model outputs into usable biomarkers for research and clinical studies.
Coordinating cross-site research activities and supervising a PhD student.

experience.role: Doctoral Researcher - AI for Digital Pathology
bullets: Built AI pipelines for digital pathology in PANCAIM, spanning tumor localization, tissue segmentation, biomarker quantification, and survival modeling from histopathology.
Developed interpretable computational pathology workflows for tumor-stroma ratio and related histologic biomarkers from routine H&E slides.
Studied how morphology-derived and learned representations support prognostic modeling in pancreatic cancer, with emphasis on reproducibility and validation.
Coordinated research workflows across collaborators, supervised junior researchers, and contributed to publications in computational pathology and clinical AI.
Built AI chatbots and conversational systems for clients in banking and automotive.
Annotated industrial data for object recognition systems and developed live translation pipelines for video content.
